relationships.subject: NaViPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: NaViPA1 expression in primary sensory neurons (PSNs) of dorsal root ganglia (DRG) produced significant inhibition of TTXs INa but not TTXr INa.

relationships.subject: NaViPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that NaViPA1 block of NaV1.7 channel activation could be via binding to the NaV1.7 protein

relationships.subject: NaViPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: DRG injection of AAV6-encoded NaViPA1 significantly attenuated evoked and spontaneous pain behaviors in both male and female rats with neuropathic pain induced by tibial nerve injury (TNI).

key_findings: NaViPA1, derived from Nav1.7 intracellular loop 1, inhibits TTX-sensitive Nav subtypes but not Nav1.5 or Nav1.8.
AAV6-NaViPA1 in DRG attenuates evoked and spontaneous neuropathic pain in rats.
